meta.description: Project and dataset change log shown on the website. Dates here are PROJECT event dates, never invented test dates.
meta.note: Reports migrated from the original community list have tested_at = null (the source gave no dates). Reports submitted later through Issue forms keep the date the tester actually provided.

updates.detail_zh: 导入通过表 85 条、问题表 10 条，共 95 条原始记录；建立 91 款独立游戏与 96 条独立测试报告。原始表格逐字存档于 docs/source-data-original.md。
updates.detail_en: Imported 85 pass-table and 10 problem-table rows (95 original records), establishing 91 distinct games and 96 independent test reports. The verbatim tables are archived in docs/source-data-original.md.

updates.title_zh: 建立游戏 / SKU / 测试报告三层数据模型
updates.title_en: Established the game / SKU / test-report data model
updates.detail_zh: 区分原始记录、独立游戏与独立测试报告；P-044 拆分为 ZSTD 与 LZ4 两条报告；疑似 SKU 单独存为未确认候选；P-034/F-002 等冲突报告全部保留。
updates.detail_en: Separated original rows, distinct games and independent reports. P-044 was split into ZSTD and LZ4 reports; suspected SKUs are kept as unconfirmed candidates; conflicting reports such as P-034/F-002 are all retained.

updates.title_zh: 上线数据校验与自动统计
updates.title_en: Added data validation and automatic statistics
updates.detail_zh: 新增 JSON Schema、Node.js 校验脚本、自动统计脚本与 GitHub Actions 校验工作流；README 统计数字由脚本核对。
updates.detail_en: Added JSON Schemas, a Node.js validator, an automatic statistics script and a GitHub Actions validation workflow; README figures are checked by script.

updates.title_zh: 收录 2 条社区测试报告
updates.detail_zh: 核实并收录 Issue #3（Dragon Quest VII Reimagined · PPSA17942 · ZSTD 失败）与 Issue #4（动物井 / Animal Well · PPSA22520 · ZSTD 通过）。社区提交使用 I-nnn 来源 ID，与 95 条逐字原始存档分开管理。
updates.detail_en: Verified and added Issue #3 (Dragon Quest VII Reimagined, PPSA17942, ZSTD fail) and Issue #4 (Animal Well, PPSA22520, ZSTD pass). Community submissions use I-nnn source ids and stay separate from the 95 verbatim archived rows.
